messages: Mia (Design): quick design sync — thinking about where the Export CTA should live on the trace/detail view. currently it's in the top-right toolbar next to Share. Feels tucked away when the trace header collapses. Sam (Product): +1. users ask for a persistent export affordance when scrolling drilldowns. Alex (Eng): technically we can pin a floating CTA anchored to the trace id area, or add it into the left rail. floating is easy but has overlay concerns. Leo (A11y): floating buttons are ok if they’re keyboard reachable and have clear aria labels. need to ensure focus order and visible focus rings. Ashley (PM): use case: support teams frequently export full trace + stacktrace as JSON/CSV for downstream triage. they also copy correlation IDs a lot. can we combine actions? Mia (Design): proposal A: keep Export in toolbar but add a sticky mini-toolbar that appears when header collapses (right below nav). Proposal B: move Copy ID + Export into a compact affordance next to the correlation pill so both stay visible during scroll. Sam (Product): Proposal B seems better for discoverability — correlation ID is the primary anchor for linking. Alex (Eng): Implementation notes: Copy ID is cheap. Export triggers backend job for large traces; we could show a small progress toast and email link when >10MB. Also need to handle export for collapsed/filtered views (should reflect current view). Mia (Design): copy ideas: primary button text = `Download trace` (preferred), secondary = `Export current view` (for current filtered view). Tooltip for correlation pill: `Copy correlation ID` + show full ID on hover. Leo (A11y): suggested aria: `aria-label="Download full trace (opens export dialog)"` for the primary. For Copy ID: `aria-label="Copy correlation ID to clipboard"` and keyboard shortcut hint `aria-describedby` referencing help text. Also ensure role=button and tabindex=0. Alex (Eng): quick example we can wire into component: ``` ``` We should also expose an accessible tooltip with `role=tooltip` and id referenced by `aria-describedby`. ``` Press Enter or Space to copy ``` Mia (Design): layout mock idea: place small Copy icon inline with corr pill, then a 3-dot overflow for Export/Download/Markdown. Overflow should have clear labels (Download JSON, Download CSV, Download PDF). Ashley (PM): question: should Export include full stackframes condensed? customers sometimes prefer expanded stack trace text. maybe include toggle `Include expanded frames` in export modal. Sam (Product): yes include toggle — default OFF to keep exports smaller. put a one-line explanation under the toggle. Leo (A11y): ensure the export modal is modal in ARIA terms: `role=dialog` + `aria-modal=true` + focus trap. Also keyboard access to the format radio group and the expanded frames checkbox. Alex (Eng): small UX edge: when trace is filtered (by service or timeframe) the export should default to `Export current view` and clearly show the filter summary at top of modal. If users want full trace, a radio option `Full trace` vs `Visible trace` is fine. Mia (Design): decision checklist: keep Copy ID inline with correlation pill (green light), add sticky mini-toolbar for exported/overflow when header collapsed (opt-in), export options in overflow menu + modal with format choices and expanded frames toggle. Ashley (PM): action items: Alex to scope estimated effort (backend job/email), Leo to draft a11y checklist, Mia to update mocks with copy and focus states, Sam to update release notes. Alex (Eng): I’ll scope today. FYI large export pipeline might reuse existing snapshot service. Leo (A11y): I'll post checklist items and quick keyboard nav test cases. Mia (Design): small copy tweak: instead of `Export current view` use `Export visible` — which is more succinct? thoughts? Sam (Product): prefer clarity: `Export current view` :thumbsup: ci-bot: deploy queued — design-assets updated (build #4872). Mia (Design): thanks — I'll attach updated Figma link in a follow-up. Ashley (PM): moving to #release-planning once scope is clear. Alex (Eng): last note — we should track metric: clicks on Copy ID and Export rate to validate improvements. Mia (Design): agreed. that'll help tune placement. thanks everyone, closing thread.
